```kotlin
    private val NAV_VERBS = listOf("打开", "跳转", "跳到", "转到", "进入", "切换", "切到", "去", "开一下", "返回", "回到")
    private val PAGE_NOUNS = listOf("页面", "界面", "页")

    private val OBJECT_WORDS = listOf("档案", "文件", "书名", "编号", "盒", "条码", "资料")

    fun match(text: String): String? {
        val t = text.trim()
        if (t.isEmpty()) return null
        if (OBJECT_WORDS.any { t.contains(it) }) return null
        val page = pageOf(t) ?: return null
        val hasNavVerb = NAV_VERBS.any { t.contains(it) }
        val hasPageNoun = PAGE_NOUNS.any { t.contains(it) }
        if (page == "home") return if (hasNavVerb) page else null
        return if (hasNavVerb || hasPageNoun) page else null
    }

    private fun pageOf(t: String): String? {
        data class Cand(val page: String, val idx: Int)
        val cands = buildList {
            BORROW_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("borrow", it)) } }
            RETURN_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("return", it)) } }
            INVENTORY_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("inventory", it)) } }
            HOME_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("home", it)) } }
        }
        return cands.minByOrNull { it.idx }?.page
    }

    fun pageName(page: String): String = when (page) {
        "borrow" -> "借阅"
        "return" -> "归还"
        "inventory" -> "盘点"
        "home" -> "首页"
        else -> page
    }

    fun navSpeech(page: String): String =
        if (page == "home") "已回到首页" else "已打开${pageName(page)}页面"
```
```
}
```

```kotlin
    private val INVENTORY_WORDS = listOf("盘点")

    private val PAGE_NOUNS = listOf("页面", "界面", "页")

    private val OBJECT_WORDS = listOf("档案", "文件", "书名", "编号", "盒", "条码", "资料")

    fun match(text: String): String? {
        val t = text.trim()
        if (t.isEmpty()) return null
        if (OBJECT_WORDS.any { t.contains(it) }) return null
        val page = pageOf(t) ?: return null
        val hasNavVerb = NAV_VERBS.any { t.contains(it) }
        val hasPageNoun = PAGE_NOUNS.any { t.contains(it) }
        if (page == "home") return if (hasNavVerb) page else null
        return if (hasNavVerb || hasPageNoun) page else null
    }

    private fun pageOf(t: String): String? {
        data class Cand(val page: String, val idx: Int)
        val cands = buildList {
            BORROW_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("borrow", it)) } }
            RETURN_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("return", it)) } }
            INVENTORY_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("inventory", it)) } }
            HOME_WORDS.forEach { w -> t.indexOf(w).takeIf { i -> i >= 0 }?.let { add(Cand("home", it)) } }
        }
        return cands.minByOrNull { it.idx }?.page
    }

    fun pageName(page: String): String = when (page) {
        "borrow" -> "借阅"
        "return" -> "归还"
        "inventory" -> "盘点"
        "home" -> "首页"
        else -> page
    }

    fun navSpeech(page: String): String =
        if (page == "home") "已回到首页" else "已打开${pageName(page)}页面"
```
```
}
```

Cap the per-day file size and/or extend the retention naming to cover the crash- prefix.

comments.content: Not rethrowing inside a crash handler is correct, but the bare catch also swallows actionable failures — mkdirs() failing, disk full, append errors — with zero signal that crash evidence was lost. A last-resort Log.e (logcat is safe in a crash handler) at least makes the loss diagnosable; also note crashFileFor()'s directory is only created once in install(), where the mkdirs() result is ignored, so a one-time failure permanently disables crash persistence with no retry.

Float prefs lack clamping/coercion on both the write and read paths. ttsVolume's setter clamps to 0.1..1 but the getter (and vadSpeechLevel()) returns whatever is stored uncoerced, so values written by older app versions or hand-edited XML (e.g., 0f or 5f) flow straight into the TTS engine — clamp on the read path just like petScale() and kwsGate() already do. Additionally, unlike petScale/kwsGate/ttsVolume, setVadSpeechLevel persists the VAD speech level with no clamping at all; note coerceIn() alone does NOT fix NaN (it passes NaN through), so guard explicitly — a NaN or extreme value (e.g., from a faulty calibration write) makes VAD permanently never (or always) detect speech, silently breaking wake behavior until prefs are cleared.
